# khaledwaleed.com

> A small, hand-built site by Khaled Waleed — lead design engineer in
> Baghdad, Iraq. Quiet pages, one painting each, plain serif text. SvelteKit
> & Go for the day job; essays, notes, and lists for the rest.

## About

- Name: Khaled Waleed (Arabic: خالد وليد)
- Also spelled: Khalid Waleed · Khaled Walid · Khalid Walid
- Role: Lead Design Engineer
- Location: Baghdad, Iraq
- Working at: QiCard (qi.iq), Vitex (vitex.dev)
- Stack: SvelteKit, Nuxt, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, Linux
- Email: contact@khaledwaleed.com

## Pages

- / — Home. The front door.
- /about — Background, work history, toolkit, and the CV as a downloadable PDF.
- /projects — Everything built and shipped: products, client work, government platforms, open source.
- /writing — Essays and notes.
- /writing/the-thin-line — How small the difference between a good person and a bad one really is.
- /writing/life-is-interesting — On meaning, and why we keep asking about it.
- /writing/bun-on-cloudflare-pages — Deploying Bun projects to Cloudflare Pages.
- /writing/sitting-in-discomfort-on-purpose — The small, private habit of voluntary difficulty.
- /likes — A scattered catalogue of obsessions: cinema, music, art, style, food, philosophy.
- /library — Books.
- /films — Every film and show I've rated, tiered.
- /music — What I'm listening to, live from Spotify.
- /contact — Email, LinkedIn, Telegram, WhatsApp, GitHub.
- /rss.xml — RSS feed for the writing.

## Style note

Each page is paired with one public-domain Northern Romantic painting
(Friedrich, Dahl, Rembrandt, Vermeer, Daguerre, Wright of Derby). The site is
set in Inter and EB Garamond. There is no JavaScript framework chrome on
display — only text, paintings, and quiet rules.
